declarations.docstring: Characterizes the linear maps in the equivariant submodule by commutation with every permutation action.
Mapping every tensor factor by a linear map commutes with the permutation representation on tensor products.
Two linear maps out of a Pi tensor product are equal when they agree on all pure tensors.
The functor sending a module to the module of equivariant maps into its Pi tensor product.
Identifies the object of the equivariant-linear-maps functor with its defining subtype.
Lifts a linear map between modules to a map between the corresponding equivariant-map submodules.
The lifted map acts on an equivariant linear map by postcomposition with the factorwise tensor map.
The lift of a composite linear map is the composite of the lifted maps.
Lifting the identity linear map gives the identity on equivariant linear maps.
The submodule of linear maps that intertwine a permutation-group representation with its action on a Pi tensor product.
The equivariant maps from the trivial representation to a Pi tensor product are linearly equivalent to its invariant tensors.
The representation of finite permutations on a Pi tensor product obtained by permuting tensor factors.
A permutation acts on a pure tensor by reindexing its factors using the inverse permutation.
